parastatals.governing_act: Gujarat Town Planning and Urban Development Act, 1976 (President's Act No. 27 of 1976) [Act number unverified: seen only in search-result snippets of the India Code and PRS PDFs, which I could not fetch]; form=statutory urban development authority (the agency's site calls it a 'development authority'; whether it is a body corporate is [unverified]); constituted under section 22(1) [unverified in the Act text: this comes from SUDA's own About page, which I fetched]; text version=none fetched [unverified]. I have not read the as-enacted or the amended consolidated text.
parastatals.current_status: Active, but this rests only on the agency's own website. Its About page (fetched 2026-10-12) lists recent notices, including a tender for an internal auditor for FY 2025-26. No gov.in or nic.in page I fetched confirms the status. I saw no source showing SUDA was renamed, merged or replaced.
parastatals.why_included: Category 1 (planning). E1: SUDA's own site says it was constituted by the Government of Gujarat under s.22(1) of the Gujarat Town Planning and Urban Development Act, 1976 to prepare the Development Plan and TP Schemes. E2-E4: it is a separate state-constituted authority. Its board is chaired by a state appointee, and the SMC Commissioner and the Standing Committee Chairman are only members. E5: it is working now. Its site shows TP schemes being prepared (e.g. preliminary TP 57), DP-2035 documents and FY2025-26 notices. A gov.in document hosted by SMC (UDD notification of 18-02-2012 under the Gujarat Regularization of Unauthorized Development Act, 2011) names 'Surat Urban Development Authority (excluding Surat Municipal Corporation area)', and SMC's Town Planning page records the 'Constitution of Urban/Area Development Authority' in 1978. E6: the own site says SUDA 'covers 195 villages surrounding to SMC and SMC too', and the 2012 notification's wording also suggests that SUDA's area includes SMC. However, SMC does development control and TP schemes inside its own limits (see UNCERTAIN). DOMAIN: sudaonline.org - proof pending, checked in the profile step.

parastatals.name: Gujarat Metro Rail Corporation Limited
parastatals.notes: Evidence: https://www.suratmunicipal.gov.in/Departments/ProjectsUnderPlanningTendering INSTRUMENTS: Act=not located (no official text of the Companies Act 1956/2013 or the Metro Railways Acts 1978/2002 was fetched; the session's tool limit was reached early); Rules=not located (also not checked: Rules under the Metro Railways Acts, and any metro fare/O&M rules for Surat); Regs=not located (Memorandum and Articles of Association not fetched; for a company these would set out the MD's and Chairman's powers); Notifications=not located (not found: GoG/GoI approval or GO assigning Surat Metro to GMRC; MEGA-to-GMRC name-change certificate; any notification extending the Metro Railways Acts to Surat). Found so far: the SMC page (gov.in, last updated 08-Aug-2022) says the Surat Metro is carried out by GMRC 'as per approval of State Govt.', that GMRC was 'formerly known as MEGA', and that the DPR was approved by GoI in March 2019. Era=n/a; the ULG is Surat Municipal Corporation (the SMC site footer calls it the official SMC website and its Acts menu lists 'The BPMC Act'); CrossLaws=not located (Gujarat service-guarantee, RTI rules and procurement schedules not checked). GMRC's website has an RTI menu: 'Details of Public Information Officer and Appellate Authority' and 'Proactive Disclosure under ... Section 4(1)(b) of RTI Act 2005' (link https://www.gujaratmetrorail.com/proactive-disclosure-under-the-provision-of-section-41b-of-rti-act-2005/ appears on the fetched page; the page itself was not fetched) | EXEC: Ambiguous, so has_chief_executive=null. The 'Present Board of Directors' page (https://www.gujaratmetrorail.com/present-board-of-directors/, fetched; modified 2026-10-08) lists: Chairman = Shri Satendra Singh, IAS, Secretary, Department of Urban Development, MoHUA, GoI (a GoI nominee holding a GoI post, so apparently part-time; not stated in an instrument); Managing Director = Shri S. S. Rathore (listed under the 'Nominated By Government of Gujarat' heading); functional directors Director (Project & Planning) and Director (Finance). The MD is a separate person from the Chairman. So category-B proof is still missing. suratmetro.org was seen only in a search result and looks unofficial (no government link, not fetched); listed for completeness only, do not treat as official | CONFIRM: (1) A person should open http://www.udd.gujarat.gov.in/projects_metro.php and https://udd.gujarat.gov.in/ (Gujarat UDD; the fetch tool returned 'url_not_allowed', which is NOT proof the pages are broken) and check whether they link to gujaratmetrorail.com, which would give the domain proof. For Surat it is PRE-OPERATIONAL: in October 2026 GMRC's website lists 'Surat Phase-1' under 'Under Implementation', and the SMC page (last updated 08-Aug-2022) says GMRC is building the Surat Metro and 'work is in progress'.

No fetched source shows that GMRC is mandated to OPERATE the Surat metro. Its own site could not be fetched because the tool limit was reached, so a build-and-operate mandate is still unverified. E2-E6 otherwise appear to pass. PRE-OPERATIONAL: under construction (work in progress according to the SMC page). NEEDS TEAM CONFIRMATION: legal form company (described as a joint SPV; 'Limited' in its name). DOMAIN: own site not fetched - proof pending.

parastatals.name: Surat Sitilink Limited
parastatals.notes: Evidence: https://www.suratmunicipal.gov.in/Content/Documents/Jobs/12022018.pdf, https://www.suratmunicipal.gov.in/Departments/BRTSCellIntroduction INSTRUMENTS: Act=not located. No official copy of the incorporation record or Companies Act provision was fetched. The company form is inferred only from the name 'Surat Sitilink Ltd.' on the SMC SARAL Pass page. Notifications=not located: no SMC General Board or Standing Committee resolution, and no Gujarat GO, creating the company or transferring BRTS and city-bus operations to it was found. CrossLaws=not located. I did not check the Gujarat RCPS Act 2013 (linked in the SMC menu) or any Gujarat service-guarantee or procurement law for a schedule naming SSL. ULG context: SMC pages say SMC is 'the Urban Local Government (ULB) for the city of Surat'. Their menu lists 'The BPMC Act' (the Act text was not fetched). The SMC BRTS Cell page (fetched, data dated 30/04/2026) says the BRTS Cell 'is responsible for development and operation of Bus Rapid Transit System for Surat city' and gives 450 electric buses operated. So SMC's own department also claims an operating role, which bears on E2 and on whether the ULG delivers the function itself. Per the team's scope note this is a ULG-owned transport SPV, so mark it NEEDS REVIEW | EXEC: not identified from official sources. Company-data aggregators (blocked, used as leads only) list a 'Managing Director' among the directors, and the recruitment.sitilink.in search snippet calls SSL a 'fully owned subsidiary company of Surat Municipal Corporation'. Neither is verified. Unknown: who holds the post, whether it is whole-time, whether the same person chairs the board, and the basis in the Articles or Board resolution. has_chief_executive=null | DOMAINS: no official domain proven. Candidates: suratsitilink.org (search title 'Surat Municipal Corporation (SMC) Public Transport'; the snippet lists SMC officials and a BRTS Traffic Cell address); sitilink.in (recruitment.sitilink.in, title 'Recruitment - Surat Sitilink Limited'); my.sitilink.in (this URL string appeared only inside a Wikipedia search result, so it is a lead only). None of the four SMC .gov.in pages I fetched links to any of these domains. The SMC pages link only to SMC's own Sitilink service pages and to the Sitilink app in the Google Play and Apple App Store listings. Both web_fetch attempts on suratsitilink.org and recruitment.sitilink.in returned url_not_allowed. That means automated tools were blocked; it does not mean the sites are broken, so a person should open them. Not yet done: no Gujarat Urban Development Department or state portal page was fetched, because the tool-use limit was reached. This is a gap in the required check | CONFIRM: (1) Open suratsitilink.org and sitilink.in by hand. Check for RTI/proactive-disclosure pages, gov.in email addresses, the CIN, and any link from an SMC or Gujarat .gov.in page. (2) Get the MCA master data (CIN U60200GJ2013SGC076328, said to be incorporated 07-Aug-2013), the MoA/AoA, and the SMC resolution forming SSL. These should confirm the Companies Act version, shareholding (wholly SMC-owned?) and board make-up. (3) Find out whether SSL has a whole-time MD or CEO, or whether an SMC officer holds the post ex officio, and who chairs the board. (4) Check whether SSL's budget is published separately or appears as a grant line in the SMC budget (https://www.suratmunicipal.gov.in/Departments/Accounts/Budget, not fetched). (5) Fetch Gujarat UD department or state portal pages to see which domain the government links to.
